content_of_post_to_comment: 900 billionaires are worth 22% of our GDP. That’s 3x the wealth concentration of the Gilded Age. We can tax that and get: Free childcare Free public college & trade schools Extend Medicare to 50 with dental, vision, & hearing And much more. This is why we need a billionaire tax.
comment: The interesting question is not only how much revenue a billionaire tax raises, but whether it changes the political incentives that allow wealth to keep concentrating in the first place.
